Script Progress: PowerShell script run.description: Report a PowerShell script to the dashboard. One run across many commands; $LASTEXITCODE is checked so a failed native command is not recorded as a success, and the finally block reports an abort.
body: # Native commands do NOT throw on a non-zero exit, so check it yourself — without this a
# failed job runs on to `complete` below and is recorded as a SUCCESSFUL run.
# --fail records the run as failed, with the reason, instead of leaving it 'running'.
# `exit`, Ctrl+C and a terminating host error all skip `catch` but still run `finally`.
# complete on an already-finished run is a no-op, so this is safe to call unconditionally;
# without it an aborted job stays status=running for ever and reads as STALLED.
